title: Over 4 Million Creators on the Lingguang App's Flash Application Platform, Making Ordinary People the Main Force in AI Application Creation

content_html:
AI application creation is moving from professional development to the masses. On August 3rd, Ling Guang App announced that the number of creators on its platform "Flash App" has exceeded 4 million, most of whom are ordinary users without a programming background, including students, teachers, psychotherapists, gaming enthusiasts, and online literature fans. As the scale of creators continues to expand and the types of applications become increasingly diverse, an AI-native application ecosystem driven by ordinary users is rapidly taking shape.

Platform data shows that gamification is currently the most active trend. Among them, "simulators" have become the most popular type this year, with nearly 10,000 related applications, covering themes such as enrollment, career, and idol cultivation. At the same time, the core value of AI applications is also expanding from efficiency tools to emotional companionship and life decision-making scenarios. For example, applications such as "emotional tests," "tarot," "AI dream interpretation," "what to eat today," and "postgraduate or work" are constantly emerging, aiming to alleviate daily decision pressure and meet the needs for light interaction and emotional release. Notably, many AI applications were created just for "fun," and entertainment is becoming an important driving force for AI creation.

As one of the core features of Ling Guang App, Flash App allows users to directly generate interactive and shareable AI applications through text, voice, and other methods. The platform transforms complex model capabilities into accessible creation tools for everyone, promoting the evolution of AI capabilities from professional development tools to content and creation infrastructure for the general public. As the creator ecosystem continues to enrich, more people are beginning to transform their personal interests, professional knowledge, and life experiences directly into AI applications. For example, psychotherapists create psychological interaction tests, teachers adapt classroom content into AI games, and the "Idol Simulator" created by college students has accumulated 13.35 million interactions so far.

content_html_zh:
AI应用创建正在从专业开发走向大众化。 8月3日，灵光App宣布，其平台“Flash App”创作者数量已突破400万，其中大部分是没有编程背景的普通用户，包括学生、教师、心理治疗师、游戏爱好者、网络文学爱好者等。 随着创作者规模不断扩大、应用类型日益丰富，一个由普通用户驱动的AI原生应用生态正在快速形成。

平台数据显示，游戏化是目前最活跃的趋势。 其中，“模拟器”成为今年最受欢迎的类型，相关应用近万个，涵盖招生、职业、偶像培养等主题。 与此同时，人工智能应用的核心价值也正在从效率工具扩展到情感陪伴和生活决策场景。 例如，“情绪测试”、“塔罗牌”、“AI解梦”、“今天吃什么”、“考研还是工作”等应用不断涌现，旨在缓解日常决策压力，满足轻互动、情绪释放的需求。 值得注意的是，许多人工智能应用只是为了“好玩”而创建的，娱乐正在成为人工智能创造的重要驱动力。

作为灵光App的核心功能之一，Flash App允许用户通过文字、语音等方式直接生成交互式、可共享的AI应用。 该平台将复杂的模型能力转化为人人可用的创作工具，推动人工智能能力从专业开发工具向普罗大众的内容和创作基础设施演进。 随着创作者生态的不断丰富，越来越多的人开始将个人兴趣、专业知识、生活经验直接转化为人工智能应用。 比如，心理治疗师打造心理互动测试、教师将课堂内容改编成AI游戏、大学生创作的《偶像模拟器》迄今累计互动1335万次。
